message: Vector Rebel 3.2.80: C-shift captain duty confirmations, inventory mapping, native one-item rotating checks, and optional dedicated-tab schedule.
releaseNotes: C-shift-only pilot: Master can confirm seven firefighters across both tour days, seed PPE gear from scoped read-only Responsible Party searches and run one native Item Log recheck per confirmed-working person. Unreadable items rotate without falsely passing. Standard Tour PPE sends discovered inventory before inspections and only native confirmed completions report verified items. Dedicated C-shift monitoring is an explicit per-tab opt-in and runs on the 7am-noon two-minute / noon-7am hourly policy only while the signed-in Vector tab remains open. User has a read-only seven-person status view. No Vector admin access, CrewSense write, or auto PPE submission.
